_comment: DELIBERATE VALIDATION FAILURES - not part of the governance corpus. build_demo_data.py appends these GovernanceRule rows after the corpus rows so that the first INTEGRATE_ALL run leaves exactly three records in error, one per check. No RuleScope or RuleCitation row references them. Each row fails one check only.

GovernanceRule.Title: [DELIBERATE FAILURE] Retired before it took effect
GovernanceRule.Statement: This deliberate test record MUST be rejected: its retirement date (2025-01-01) is before its effective date (2026-01-01).

GovernanceRule.Title: [DELIBERATE FAILURE] Approved rule without any scope
GovernanceRule.Statement: This deliberate test record MUST be rejected: it is APPROVED but has no scope row, so no design agent could ever find it.

GovernanceRule.Title: [DELIBERATE FAILURE] Rule without a statement
GovernanceRule.Rationale: Demonstrates the mandatory check on Statement.
